name: Other countries
levelNote: Rules for electronic signatures differ by country. This is a simple electronic signature; some documents need more where you live.
ageNote: Eighteen is assumed; the age may be higher where you live.

formRequirements.note: Wills almost everywhere need a handwritten signature or a notary.
Property transfers usually need a notary or registry formalities.
Family-law documents are commonly excluded from simple electronic signatures.
